full_name: Torben Iversen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Social Sciences Catherine A. and Mary C. Gellert Fellow Harvard University
bio: Torben Iversen is the Harold Hitchings Burbank Professor of Political Economy in the Department of Government at Harvard University. His research interests include comparative political economy, electoral politics, and applied formal theory. His most recent book, with David Soskice, is Democracy and Prosperity: Reinventing Capitalism through a Turbulent Century (Princeton University Press, 2019).
